tools.name: searchPostmanElements
tools.usedIn: Find the NBA GameDay workspace, collection, or request
tools.description: Search requests, collections, workspaces, specs, or environments.

arguments.entityType: requests | collections | workspaces | specs | environments | mocks | documents

tools.name: createEnvironment
tools.description: Create an environment in a workspace. Secret variables are masked.

arguments.environment.name: Display name.
arguments.environment.values: Array of { key, value, type, enabled }. type is default or secret.

tools.name: createCollection
tools.description: Create a collection in Collection v2.1 format, including requests and prerequest or test events.

arguments.collection.info: { name, schema }. schema is the v2.1 collection schema URL.
arguments.collection.event: listen is prerequest or test. script.exec is the JavaScript, one string per line.
